RPSC APO Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the Answer Key for the post of Assistant Prosecution Officer APO. This recruitment was released for 371 posts. Applications for Rajasthan RPSC APO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 08 June 2026 to 07 July 2026. The written examination was conducted on 02 September 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this Examination can download their RPSC APO Answer Key 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 27 May 2026
  • Application Start Date : 08 June 2026
  • Last Date : 07 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 07 July 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 17 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 02 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 26 August 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 30 August 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 27 December 2026
  • Pre Answer Key : 07 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 600/-
  • OBC, BC : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 400/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
